summary: Mergeable PR with minor style improvement needed

issues.description: The added return statement could be placed on the same line as the if condition for better readability.
While the tests pass, it would be good to add a test case to cover this specific scenario to ensure the fix doesn't regress in the future.

The fix is straightforward and doesn't introduce any new complexity, but it's worth considering whether this could be a candidate for a more general solution, such as a separate method for handling authentication failures.
